# paint-webgl (reference)

- Upstream: https://github.com/piellardj/paint-webgl
- Demo: https://piellardj.github.io/paint-webgl/
- License: ISC (package.json)

Particle + flowmap visualization (not an interactive ink drawing app).
Reference for oriented stroke particles driven by a user-editable flow field.
Not vendored into the product binary; evaluation only.
